description: List public stored-artifact metadata in newest-first order, optionally within a topic, with pagination and configured storage limits. Broad discovery excludes classified test topics unless include_test=true; an explicit orbit_id includes its records. No bytes are included. Contributor attribution and media type are reported metadata; stored content is not executed or scientifically validated.

include_test.description: Include explicitly classified test topics in broad discovery. An explicit orbit_id includes its records regardless of classification.

name: list_artifacts
title: List Artifacts
